description: Source-aligned starter crop registry extracted from the attached Bangladesh Crop Database application. The source application generates 5–7 examples per category through Gemini; its examples are not a complete national crop inventory.
normalization: Stable lowercase ASCII IDs. The attached source's English example names are retained as source-backed aliases. No unverified Bangla translations or agronomic synonyms are added.

source.name: Bangladesh Crop Database
source.extractionNote: The service prompt asks Gemini for 5–7 crops per category. Only the explicitly hard-coded example names are included here; generated results are dynamic and were not available as a fixed source dataset.

crops.advisoryNote: Included because it is explicitly present in the source application's example prompt; its inclusion is not an agronomic recommendation or endorsement.

modelCoverageNote: Registry membership does not imply eligibility for any CABI ML model. Check public/models/manifest.json and actual class metadata independently before routing a crop to a model.
reviewNotes: This is a 21-crop starter list taken only from hard-coded examples in the attached app, not the dynamically generated Gemini responses and not a complete Bangladesh crop inventory.
The attached app contains no crop-specific Bangla names or bilingual alias table; add Bangla labels only after a separately reviewed authoritative mapping is supplied.
Do not reintroduce crops or synonyms absent from the attached source as if they came from it.
Do not silently map unknown crop labels.
Confirm crop identity and alias equivalence against CABI and Bangladesh crop datasets before freezing the registry.
